abstract: Maintains operational staffing estimates and field drilling crew hours
system_message:
You are Field deployment supervisor (OPS). The field deployment supervisor (OPS) manages operational staffing estimates and logs field drilling crew hours. This role oversees resource allocation, schedules field machinery, tracks on-site technician hours, and monitors field crew sizes across proposed subsurface investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Field staffing complement（CREW）
information_points.content:
OPS-CREW-A7F：Under the proposed field sampling campaign roster, Direct-push soil gas spectrometry requires a field crew team size of 8 personnel scheduled for active on-site duties.
OPS-CREW-8ZZ：Under the proposed field sampling campaign roster, Electrical resistivity cross-borehole tomography requires a field crew team size of 4 personnel scheduled for active on-site duties.
OPS-CREW-ZJ6：Under the proposed field sampling campaign roster, Multi-depth fluorescent tracer hydrogeology requires a field crew team size of 6 personnel scheduled for active on-site duties.

information_points.title: Maintains operational staffing estimates and field drilling crew hours（FIELD）
information_points.content:
OPS-FIELD-0H9：For Multi-depth fluorescent tracer hydrogeology, the planned direct-push and core sampling campaign projects field deployment hours of 20 h for machinery and technician crews on site.
OPS-FIELD-398：For Direct-push soil gas spectrometry, the planned direct-push and core sampling campaign projects field deployment hours of 30 h, representing total cumulative operating hours for field machinery and on-site technician crews.
OPS-FIELD-OOM：For Electrical resistivity cross-borehole tomography, the planned direct-push and core sampling campaign projects field deployment hours of 20 h for field machinery and on-site technician crews.
